instruction: Under -race on a loaded machine, two of the tests' bounded waits for something that must happen are too short and flake. Raise them from 2 seconds to 5: the wait in the recv helper in internal/relay/relay_test.go, and the deadline in TestEventsClosesOnContextCancel in internal/httpapi/events_test.go, together with that test's failure message, which names the 2s and must say 5s. Every other wait stays as it is, including the two 2-second waits inside TestHubSlowSubscriberIsDisconnectedNotDropped and the 150ms window in expectNothing. Change nothing else.

require.match: case <-time\.After\(5 ?\* ?time\.Second\):\n\s*t\.Fatal\("timed out waiting for a message"\)
t\.Fatal\("subscription still live 5s after the request was cancelled — the handler leaked it"\)
